ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (27) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Благо» (blago) is 'the good' ('their good'), where the website draft had 'welfare', and «совершенствование в добре» (sovershenstvovanie v dobre) is 'perfecting in good'. Lichtenberg's italics (*retell*, *done*, *history of the learned*) and Confucius's *true* are kept, «последняя из наук» (poslednyaya iz nauk) stays 'the last of the sciences', and «Персидский Дэзатир» (Persidskiy Dezatir) is 'Persian Desatir', the established English spelling of the book's name.
Source observation: [25] The attribution «*Торо*» (Toro, 'Thoreau') lacks a final period, unlike the other attributions; probably a transcription slip. English mirrors it.
